_note: English versions of the zh concept queries, translated blind (no access to the code) by a separate model, as Claude would rewrite them before calling semantic_search. Used by run.py option tr=1.
P2 存档先写临时文件再替换，防止断电损坏: write save to a temp file then replace the original to prevent corruption on power loss
存档文件损坏时另存一份原件: back up the original save file when the save file is corrupted
主存档读不出来时改用备份文件: fall back to the backup save file when the main save cannot be read
关闭背包时光标上还拿着物品，放回原格或背包，放不下就掉在脚下: on closing inventory with an item held on cursor, return it to its original slot or inventory, otherwise drop it at feet
每帧开头检查 P2 临时上下文是否残留并自动复位: at the start of each frame, check whether the P2 temporary context is left over and auto-reset it
某个补丁在游戏更新后失效时只跳过它，不让整个 mod 加载失败: skip a patch that fails after a game update instead of failing the whole mod load
输入重定向补丁加载时自检，完全没生效就记日志: self-check the input redirection patch on load and log if it has no effect
分屏期间关掉的垂直同步不要写进游戏设置，退出后恢复: do not persist vsync disabled during split screen to game settings, restore it on exit
联机或有其他真实玩家时不生成第二个玩家: do not spawn a second player when online or when other real players are present
P2 打开研究台时占用它，P1 不能同时打开: P2 opening the research station claims it so P1 cannot open it at the same time
进入新世界时清空 P2 的装备，避免带进别的存档被复制: clear P2 equipment on entering a new world to prevent it being copied into another save
P1 倒在木筏外面时尸体和镜头乱飞的稳定处理: stabilize corpse and camera when P1 falls down outside the raft
背包能扩展多少格取决于装备的背包: inventory slot expansion count depends on the equipped backpack
按 B 关闭菜单的同一帧被误读成蹲下: pressing B to close the menu is misread as crouch on the same frame
灯光图层遮罩不要每帧扫描全场景，做节流: throttle light layer mask updates instead of scanning the entire scene every frame
跳过符号链接和目录联接，防止读到仓库外面的文件: skip symlinks and directory junctions to prevent reading files outside the repository
文件在外部被删除后不要再出现在搜索结果里: remove files from search results after they are deleted externally
显存不够时把批次拆小重试: split the batch into smaller chunks and retry on out-of-memory GPU error
防止同时启动多个后台服务进程: prevent launching multiple background service processes at the same time
把相邻的很小的方法合并成一个块: merge adjacent very small methods into a single chunk
只有 import 语句的空隙不要单独成块: do not make a separate chunk for gaps that contain only import statements
修改配置文件前先备份: back up the config file before modifying it
